<h2>About Us</h2>
<p><a href="https://www.kitebeachinn.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/pool-area.jpg"><img fetchpriority="high" decoding="async" class="alignnone size-full wp-image-5078" src="https://www.kitebeachinn.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/pool-area.jpg" alt="pool-area" width="940" height="475" srcset="https://www.kitebeachinn.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/pool-area.jpg 940w, https://www.kitebeachinn.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/pool-area-300x151.jpg 300w, https://www.kitebeachinn.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/pool-area-540x272.jpg 540w" sizes="(max-width: 940px) 100vw, 940px" /></a></p>
<p>Kite Beach Inn is an <strong>oceanfront hotel</strong> located right on Kite Beach in Cabarete, Puerto Plata. We cater to kiteboarders, kitesurfers, surfers and beach vacationers.</p>
<p><a href="https://www.kitebeachinn.com/about-us">Read more</a></div></div><div class="fusion-one-fourth one_fourth fusion-layout-column fusion-column spacing-yes"><div class="fusion-column-wrapper">
